integrity: Analytic proof of all interval-pair inequalities and parameter boundaries in RESULT.md. CHECK.py is supplementary finite sampling, not a proof. First verified public date is the 20 November 2026 new-listing date of arXiv:2611.24942v1, despite an inconsistent source header date.
scientific_limitations: Pointwise supremum over real Hilbert-space nearisometries; no common extremizer for all radii, no extremizer classification, and no complex-space claim. Large-radius attainment and the universal upper bound are previously known; originality is the exact short-radius attainment and the resulting complete envelope. Full independent audit unperformed. An unindexed equivalent short-radius construction remains possible.
title: Exact short-radius sharpness for transverse defects of approximate Hilbert isometries
